PRINCIPLE/RATIONALE: Assertions should verify multiple properties. EVALUATION: This test asserts multiple properties (initial sizes for two stacks, size after push for both stacks, popped value, and final size), i.e., multiple meaningful assertions. DECISION: >=2 properties verified -> compliant.
